verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Visalaw AI analyzing documents that have already been gathered: extracting fields from client PDFs, listing RFE deadlines and required items, and a generic claim to "automate entire workflows." Nothing documents a structured evidence-collection workflow with checklists, client uploads or reminders. Those adjacent analysis features do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
